labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Campaign sync: clicks in Setup, separated by |
labels.value: Click the permission set those people have (or open Profiles for their profile).|Click Object Settings, then Campaigns, then Edit.|Tick Read, Create and Edit, then click Save.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Campaign sync: what to change
labels.value: Let the people who create appeals create and edit Campaigns, through their profile or a permission set. Give yourself Campaign Sync on the Access page, under Extra Permissions.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Campaign sync: why it needs Setup
labels.value: A Campaign is created with the access of the person saving the appeal; without it the appeal still saves, and Sync all appeals catches it up.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Campaign sync Marketing User: clicks, separated by |
labels.value: Click Edit next to the person.|Tick Marketing User.|Click Save.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Campaign sync Marketing User: what to change
labels.value: Tick Marketing User on the user of each person who creates appeals.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Campaign sync Marketing User: why it needs Setup
labels.value: Salesforce lets only a Marketing User create Campaigns, and that box is on the user in Setup.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Opportunity mirror: clicks in Setup, separated by |
labels.value: Click the permission set your fundraising staff have (or open Profiles for their profile).|Click Object Settings, then Opportunities, then Edit.|Tick Read, Create and Edit, then click Save.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Opportunity mirror: what to change
labels.value: To give each gift its Opportunity at once, let fundraising staff create and edit Opportunities through their profile or a permission set. Give yourself Opportunity Mirror on the Access page.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Opportunity mirror: why it needs Setup
labels.value: Opportunities are written with the access of the person saving the gift; without it the nightly run catches them up instead.
